quest.title: A Tea Party Most Thorny
quest.description: Now that the serial disappearances case has been solved, you decide to rest up for a while, but something is stirring in the dark...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x850, Mora x36825, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

chapter.title: To the Stars Shining in the Depths

talks.objective: Return to Spina di Rosula's base in the Court of Fontaine

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yep, here's the room, and it's empty and waiting for us as promised! Navia is such a good person.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now that the serial disappearances case has been solved, no one's going to come after us for anything. Even without Silver standing guard, we can just completely relax!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why don't we stay and rest up here for a while? Even machines in Fontaine need to stop and recharge now and then.

choices.text: If we wanted to rest...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: C'mon, this place isn't that bad. Besides, how often do we get to stay in an actual base?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The truth, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, fine, fine!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Remember that detective story Paimon read before? Well, the author is about to release a new book, so Paimon wanted to buy it as soon as it came out and have a quiet place to read it...

choices.text: Fair enough.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yipee! Then it's agreed! Come on, let's get some sleep. We'll need to be up first thing in the morning to get in line and buy a copy!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You and Paimon relax for a while at Spina di Rosula's base in the Court of Fontaine...

choices.text: Just don't spoil the ending for me this time.
Couldn't we pick somewhere with a decent view?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon didn't expect that style at all! Even though it's a detective novel, it's also like a social documentary... hmm, it's actually pretty good.

choices.text: You just finished it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: N—No... Paimon just spends a bit more time sleeping than you, that's all!

response.speaker: Isadora
response.text: #Excuse me... But do you know if {NICKNAME} and Paimon are lodging here?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Who're you? Paimon doesn't recall seeing you before... Wait, you're not here to give us trouble, are you?

response.speaker: Isadora
response.text: A blond traveler and a chatty little fairy... Whew, looks like I've found the place. Good thing I asked the Spina di Rosula, seems they sent me the right way.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, what do you mean by "chatty"!? Paimon's always careful not to talk too much! ...Most of the time, anyway...

response.speaker: Isadora
response.text: It's an honor to meet you both. I was sent from the Palais Mermonia. Monsieur Neuvillette wishes to see you. It seems he has something important to discuss in person.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Neuvillette? He wants to see us again already? We talked so much the last time we met, has something happened since then?

response.speaker: Isadora
response.text: I am not privy to the details. It would be best if you came to the Palais Mermonia and asked Monsieur Neuvillette in person.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If you say so... But Paimon has a bad feeling about this...

response.speaker: Isadora
response.text: Now that I've delivered the message, I'll take my leave.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Thanks! We haven't left the room for a few days, so we'll head over once we've freshened up a bit.

choices.text: You're a pretty slow reader, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Neuvillette! We're here! Did you want to see us about something?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Why were you just standing there? You daydreaming, or thinking something over?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Yes... I did send someone to fetch you. But as for what I'd like to discuss next... Well, I still have some reservations...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Given that we've already made the trip here, you should just tell us! Bet you need us to help you with something, right?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I do indeed have something I'd like to ask you to do, however... you should wait until after I tell you the details, then decide for yourselves whether you'd like to help or not.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: The situation is this...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: ...If I am understanding you correctly, the Snezhnayan Harbinger known as The Knave has essentially requested a diplomatic meeting with you, correct?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I heard that she was originally from Fontaine, but for her to suddenly arrive here and abruptly request such a meeting like this...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I sincerely advise you to refuse her invitation outright.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I'm sure you're aware that her purpose is most likely related to Childe's recent predicament...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: We convicted one of the Snezhnayan Harbingers in a court of law, but we have yet to provide any form of detailed report on the matter. This does indeed provide an opportunity for Snezhnaya to put pressure on us.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I believe we should adopt an evasive stance until we can provide a proper explanation and have a preliminary plan on how to deal with the matter.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: No... we shouldn't... I think we should agree to the meeting.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Oh?

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Well, you see... we are the ones that owe an explanation. If we keep putting off the meeting, it could easily result in the problem escalating, right?

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: It's like... like a fight between two friends. If they don't agree to see each other and talk in person, isn't it possible that the friendship could end entirely?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Though diplomatic relations between Fontaine and Snezhnaya could be considered as friendly, it is only superficially so. You wouldn't go so far as to say that our nations are "friends" as you did in your example.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: *sigh* It was just an analogy... an analogy, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Moreover, even if we were to talk in person, if we don't have sufficient information prepared, it is quite possible the result wouldn't be restored relations, but a complete falling-out.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Hmm, I don't think we should overthink those possibilities yet... *ahem* Even if the logic of the divine is not immediately apparent, its wisdom will only be revealed with time.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Besides, you'll be at the meeting! If any problems do pop up, you'll have no problem navigating them.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I must clarify that interacting and communicating with people outside of court is not my cup of tea. It seems you think too much of me.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: But more importantly... When did I agree to join the meeting with you?

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Eeeeh!? You mean you won't come? No... no no no, that won't do! I can't go to the meeting alone, you have to accompany me, I must take you with me...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Lady Furina, could there be something else regarding this matter that is being kept from me?

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: No, not at all... Look, I am the Hydro Archon of Fontaine, Focalors. The God of Justice, who is loved and adored by many...

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: So, I only hope that justice will be served in this matter. Don't overthink it... I'll go find someone to arrange the meeting...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The time for the meeting with The Knave that Lady Furina insisted upon arrives...

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: Though it could officially be considered a diplomatic conference, I prefer to see our meeting today as an ordinary tea party.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: I assume you see it the same way, Miss Furina?

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: Lady Furina?

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Ah? Oh... yes, yes, that's right! Just like you said, a tea party. I should thank you for providing the pastries, they look delectable.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: To make this tea party even more lively, I've invited someone else to join us today...

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: It's a pleasure to meet you, Monsieur Neuvillette. I was born in Fontaine, so naturally, there's no need to introduce the nation's revered Iudex to me.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Hello, the pleasure is also mine.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: First, I would like to thank the two of you. I'm often away on business outside of Fontaine, and I'm told that the children of the House of the Hearth have been well taken care of by you.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Uh...

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: Oh, I'm not referring to when my children Lyney and Lynette were falsely accused by you, please don't misunderstand.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: The children of the House of the Hearth are often misunderstood, perhaps due to the reputation of the Fatui. There's no getting around that.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: All I meant to say is that Fontaine has been stable in recent years. The people are well off and the children lead happy, fulfilled lives.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: That is something truly worth cherishing, and no one wishes to disrupt such peace...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Now then. You have come regarding the matter of Childe, correct?

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: Well, yes... It appears the ever-busy Iudex Neuvillette doesn't wish to waste time with diplomatic pleasantries and hopes that we can get straight to the point of our talk.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: Yes, as you surmised, understanding Childe's situation is indeed one of the goals of this trip.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: As we are both diplomats from Snezhnaya as well as Fatui Harbingers, Childe and I have always been colleagues...

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: Were anything to happen in Fontaine, each of us would serve as the other's attorney to resolve the issue.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: So now, in my capacity as his attorney, I request that Childe be turned over to Snezhnaya. We have a responsibility to cooperate with Fontaine and resolve what has happened to him together.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: The rules governing attorneys only apply before a trial has concluded. Since a verdict has already been rendered, we see the case as settled. I apologize for being unable to grant your request.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: An outright refusal... Very well. I respect all the rules of Fontaine's courts, just as I respect you as Chief Justice.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: Okay, why don't we back up a step?

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: You don't need to transfer Childe to us. I only request to enter the Fortress of Meropide to see Childe and confirm his condition.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: It's not like you couldn't even manage to fulfill a simple request like that, right, Miss Furina?

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Uh, um, about th—that...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: The Fortress of Meropide has always been completely autonomous. Even we have no authority to interfere there, and diplomatic issues do not suffice as an excuse.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: However, if you absolutely must confirm the situation of the Harbinger, I have a proposal...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Knave showed up already? Well, Lyney did say that "Father will be returning soon"...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We didn't even know that Lyney was from the House of the Hearth at the time, so we kinda overlooked that information.

choices.text: Please be careful, Neuvillette.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Yes, thank you for your kind advice. I'm well aware of the situation.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: I also noticed that Lady Furina acts a little odd and unnatural whenever I bring up matters related to The Knave...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Could The Knave be threatening Lady Furina or something?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: If that were the case, then why wouldn't Lady Furina inform me? And what means could The Knave possibly have to twist the arm of an archon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, so maybe that's not very likely... Even though Furina can act a little weird at times, she's still an Archon...

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: In reality, this problem is even more thorny than it appears. According to reports from the Fortress of Meropide, Childe recently disappeared under mysterious circumstances.

choices.text: Disappeared?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: The details are still unclear. We cannot rule out an escape, but there have also been no reports of him outside of the Fortress of Meropide.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Special guards oversee the Fortress, and its internal systems are extensive. Combined with the special characteristics of the surrounding terrain, an escape should not be possible. I suspect that there's something else behind Childe's disappearance.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: I was only willing to share this information with you because you are friends of Childe, and it is my duty to see justice done.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So this is what you wanted to see us about before...

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Yes. I would like you to go to the Fortress of Meropide and investigate Childe's disappearance.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: This was my proposal during our meeting with The Knave. Rather than allowing her to intervene, I offered to send someone to find out about Childe's situation and report back to her in detail.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: The Knave did not seem satisfied by my proposal, but she still agreed to go along with it for the time being. Her words were, "We will talk more once we have that report."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So that means we bought ourselves some time.

choices.text: But why do you want us to go?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Firstly, you're already acquainted with Childe. Your eyes may discern relevant details there that others would miss.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: And secondly is the consideration of the unique nature of the Fortress of Meropide...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Isn't it just Fontaine's prison?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: I would not define it so crudely. The Fortress of Meropide is not affiliated with the court system of Fontaine on paper. It has always existed as an "autonomous" entity.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Early in Fontaine's history, criminals were punished with exile, not imprisonment. Even today, sentences against convicted criminals still include exile, just as before.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: The Fortress of Meropide may seem like a prison, but it should in fact be regarded as a gathering place for exiles.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: All we do is dispatch guards to keep watch and help maintain security, but we have no right to get involved with any other matters.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Although I do have a personal relationship with the administrator there, neither myself nor the courts have the right to be directly involved with the investigation, no matter how serious the grounds.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Paimon gets it now! That's why you need us to conduct our own investigation as a third party, right?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Correct. I will arrange false charges against you so that you may secretly investigate inside the fortress during your detention. This will save us a lot of unnecessary trouble.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: So, are you two willing to accept my proposal?

choices.text: Since you're in such a tough spot...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, no matter how you look at it, it seems we're the best choice. Alright, we hereby accept this difficult task... uh, reluctantly!

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: You two have my sincere thanks. This matter is of critical importance to Fontaine's current situation. Also, I hope that both of you can keep this operation a secret.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: We will rendezvous at the Fortress of Meropide's entrance on Erinnyes once you've prepared yourselves. I will arrange for someone to take you inside.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Prepared ourselves...? Uh, is there something we need to prepare?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Perhaps you could enjoy a good meal and have a nice bath. I'm afraid that living conditions inside the Fortress are nothing like those on the outside world.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, right! Even though we'll be there on trumped-up charges, we'll be in prison for real...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, on second thought... Is it too late to back out?

choices.text: You didn't even consider the fact we'd be prisoners?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Please, do not worry. Since you are sacrificing both your time and quality of life for the sake of delivering this report...

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: You will be compensated according to the highest standards permitted to legal staff, regardless of the outcome.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Now that's more like it... C'mon {NICKNAME}, let's go eat the best meal we can find! We'll eat so much that we won't need to eat another meal for a whole month, your treat!

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Are you leaving now? In that case, please take this cake as a token of my personal gratitude.

choices.text: We've already agreed, Paimon. Just accept it.
Well, Childe is our friend, after all...
Wouldn't it be more convenient to have an official from Fontaine do this?
Did he escape?
The Knave won't be easy to deal with.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon'll have that, and that... Oh! And one of those too! And no Fonta! Thank you!

choices.text: You sure ordered a lot...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That cake was pretty good, but as soon as Paimon remembered that we're about to go to prison, Paimon's stomach suddenly became completely empty!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now that Paimon thinks about it, we've always been super careful ever since we arrived in Fontaine, just to avoid breaking any strange laws here...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But here we are, about to willingly send ourselves off to the Fortress of Meropide... Maybe this is what they call fate.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* Let's just try our best to investigate everything quickly once we get there... Paimon doesn't want to stay in prison too long...

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Oh, what is that I hear? Is it the taste of a breaking story?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, you can't hear a taste! And what are you doing here, Charlotte?

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Ugh, don't remind me... I invited an eyewitness to a case to eat here, and I was planning to get some great material out of him... But he didn't even show up!

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: #*sigh* Calm down, calm down... This is nothing new, as a journalist, you should be used to this by now... as long as you can score some juicy tidbits from {NICKNAME}, you might still be able to recover the cost of the meal...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, you know we can still hear you, Charlotte...

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Hahaha! Never mind, it's nothing... I just heard you mention the Fortress of Meropide. You didn't commit a crime, did you? Please tell me all about it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No way, we would never! We're just going there to...

choices.text: Ahem...!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh no, Paimon almost forgot that Neuvillette told us to keep it a secret...

choices.text: We're going to serve our sentences and redeem ourselves...

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Huh? You're being arrested for that?

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Oh... But now that I think about it, I suppose that's not completely unreasonable. That's pretty despicable, almost as offensive as committing theft.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh...? You mean Paimon really did something that serious?

choices.text: See? I told you, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sorry! Paimon really messed up!

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Hmm, in that case, it's nothing particularly newsworthy after all... How disappointing...

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Oh, right, there's still a chance... Since you're going to be at the Fortress of Meropide... Would you be willing to help me gather some material for a story?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, about that... Paimon doesn't think we'll have any time...

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Ah, it's nothing difficult. All you have to do is think of a way to get some time face to face with the warden of the fortress.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: He was awarded the honorary title of "Duke" in Fontaine. Sounds really cool huh? Only those who have made significant contributions to the nation have been conferred this title, it's incredibly rare.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: On top of that, the Fortress of Meropide has never been under the jurisdiction of the courts. Practically nobody, including journalists like me, knows anything about the person in charge there.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: If I could write an exclusive article about him, I bet it would sell a boatload of papers!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You make it sound easy, but it really depends...

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Of course, I wouldn't ask you to do it for free, so this meal is on me!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, you've got a deal! We'll do anything you want!

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Hehe, then it's settled! The food should be here any second, right? Huh!? Wait, just how much did you order!?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: After completely stuffing yourselves, you prepare to go to the Fortress of Meropide...

choices.text: You didn't even think anything of it at the time.
For spoiling the ending of a detective novel in public.
ACHOO!
Didn't you just finish eating the cake that Neuvillette gave us?

talks.objective: Find Neuvillette at the entrance to the Fortress of Meropide

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright Neuvillette, we're ready. Is this where the entrance is?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: You have come, just as promised. Yes, this is the one and only entrance to the Fortress of Meropide from Erinnyes.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Careful, you may want to step back a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! So you have to go down from here... is the prison underwater?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Utilizing both the barrier of the water as well as the fear humans have of the depths, the Fortress of Meropide is naturally the perfect place to confine and guard criminals.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: But do not worry, it's not nearly as frightening inside as you may think. You will see for yourselves once you're down there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, Paimon hopes you're right... Dunno about you, but just thinking about being at the bottom of the sea like that gives Paimon the heebie-jeebies!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Oh, and there's one more thing... I mentioned that I have had personal dealings with the administrator of the Fortress, Wriothesley... He's a very... shrewd fellow.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, we've heard about him too. He's that "Duke," right?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Correct. He is the highest ranking manager of the underwater prison. Even though you are going there to investigate at my behest, it would behoove you to avoid any confrontation with him or any of his subordinates.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: The Duke rarely ever leaves the Fortress of Meropide, but that does not mean he is not privy to all that's happening inside and outside the fortress. He is "quiet," but not "unaware," so please bear that in mind.

choices.text: The Duke, Wriothesley...

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Alright, that's about all the time that we have to talk privately. I am counting on you two.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry, we won't let you down!

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Good. Madeleine...

response.speaker: Madeleine
response.text: I'm here, Monsieur Neuvillette. These two are the newest convicts, I presume? Don't worry, they won't escape on my watch.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph, like we would try!

response.speaker: Madeleine
response.text: Please follow me, you two. I'll process your paperwork for entering the Fortress of Meropide.

choices.text: I'll keep that in mind.

talks.objective: Ride the lift and enter the Fortress of Meropide

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Ride the elevator

talks.objective: Talk to Marette and complete the required procedures

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Oh, no need to thank me for it. Just be sure to enjoy it.

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: Please use the elevator to proceed below.

dialogues.speaker: Marette
dialogues.text: *yawn* Oh, it's you Madeleine. Why'd they make you make the trip down here today?

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: Monsieur Neuvillette personally requested I escort these two convicts. I suppose he was concerned others might not be up to the task.

dialogues.speaker: Marette
dialogues.text: *sigh* Well now, aren't you the lucky one... Must be nice to be on good terms with the big shots like the Chief Justice. The only people I get to see every day are the new inmates.

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: Well, have you tried "service with a smile"? Who knows, it might help your professional reputation.

dialogues.speaker: Marette
dialogues.text: Yeah right, as if. Every criminal comes through here looking miserable. How can I smile with such a toxic work environment?

dialogues.speaker: Marette
dialogues.text: And even if I did smile at them, the convicts would probably just think that I'm some freak getting some kind of twisted enjoyment from their pain.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, she's got a point.

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: Well, I've finished transferring you. You two will register here, and Marette will guide you through the remaining procedures.

dialogues.speaker: Marette
dialogues.text: *sigh* Yep, I'll take it from here. You head on back to that bright and sunny world above.

dialogues.speaker: Marette
dialogues.text: #Okay, let me see... You are {NICKNAME} and Paimon, correct?

choices.text: Present.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That would be us.

response.speaker: Marette
response.text: Let me confirm your charges and sentence. Let's see, you two are charged with...

response.speaker: Marette
response.text: ...Eating a cake specially prepared for the archon by a Snezhnayan envoy without the archon's permission, thereby incapacitating the political center of Fontaine for a brief period. Sentence: 45 days...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Wait, you mean the cake that Neuvillette gave us was...

response.speaker: Marette
response.text: Just looking at the charges... It seems you two are capable of causing some serious trouble.

response.speaker: Marette
response.text: And considering how fond Lady Furina is of sweets, this crime is tantamount to trying to assassinate the Hydro Archon herself.

choices.text: You flatter us.

response.speaker: Marette
response.text: Now I've seen everything... Anyway, we still need to finish processing you before you can enter the Fortress of Meropide.

response.speaker: Marette
response.text: Please stand in front of the board over there. I'll take your mug shots with my Kamera.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, alright... But be sure to catch Paimon's good side!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Under Marette's guidance, you complete all the required procedures...

response.speaker: Marette
response.text: ...And we're done. Thank you for your cooperation. Next, someone will be along to guide you inside the fortress. Please be sure to cherish this opportunity for rebirth.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? "Rebirth"? Isn't that a little much? We're only going to be here for 45 days.

response.speaker: Deakin
response.text: You two are the new inmates, right? Follow me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Oh, okay. Paimon is Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}...

response.speaker: Deakin
response.text: Save it, it's not like I'll remember your names. Move it.

choices.text: You really have an eye for criminals.
That's right.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: I had no idea you could eat so much! That didn't go according to plan... Please, please don't forget about the material for my news article!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y'know, we've been walking around for a while now. Why don't we go back to the Spina di Rosula base in the Court of Fontaine and have a rest?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Navia said something about having a place ready for us there, didn't she? C'mon, let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, Paimon's so full... Well, guess we have nothing to regret now, so let's get going!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, wait... Paimon just said something really ominous, didn't she?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are we already underwater now...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So this is what it feels like to be a criminal in Fontaine...

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: You two seem to be taking this pretty well. It's rare to see convicts in such a good mood.
